author: Shurtz, Ammon; Richardson, Christian; Richardson, Stephen D.
title: MekongPhon: A Large-Scale Parallel IPA Corpus for Lao and Khmer
scope: Paper reports 367,388 Lao orthography–IPA sentence pairs; seed lexicon has 6,039 word–IPA entries derived from Kerr (1972), with a two-author 500-entry review (97.2% sample accuracy; reviewers are proficient L2 speakers, not native speakers). Paper states resources are publicly released for future research and cites the generic SEAlang Creative Commons reuse notice; exact CC version/scope is unspecified. Lao downloader uses NLLB v1 and ParaCrawl-Bonus v9; OpenSubtitles v2024 appears in the Khmer downloader, despite the paper prose listing it among OPUS sources. The 100-entry Lao held-out lexicon benchmark is dictionary-seeded and distinct from the OPUS sentence corpus; limited internal non-commercial use is aggregate-only, ephemeral and non-redistributive. Not independent project gold. Repository snapshot f80f6c1840c4818b51e05f2e00cded4701a5b662 has no declared dataset license/root LICENSE; rights_status=UNKNOWN for redistribution, derivatives and broader use.
